title: Where do reviewer answers go?
subtitle: One choice, before the export path is built
audience: Product owner; no code knowledge needed
ask: Pick one of the three options, and mark anything you disagree with on the way.
afterwards: Your pick is what I build in v0.1. If you mark the recommendation "revisit", I draft two more options instead of building.

options.label: Revisit
options.hint: Right question, not ready to decide

recommended.why: It is the only option that works offline and for a reviewer with no account.

sections.label: Where I could be wrong
sections.description: If I were you, I would push back on these. Agree means the concern is real.

items.title: The reviewer exports a file and sends it back
items.summary: One click saves feedback.json; the reviewer emails or drops it wherever the agent can read it.
items.body: Answers autosave in the reviewer's own browser while they work. Nothing leaves the machine until they choose to send the file.

fields.assumes: The reviewer can send a file back (email, chat, shared folder).
fields.risk: They forget to send it, and the agent waits.
fields.would_change_my_mind: Most reviewers turn out to be colleagues on the same hosted workspace.

items.title: Answers save to a hosted database as the reviewer works
items.summary: No export step; the agent reads answers the moment they are given.

fields.assumes: A server we run, and an account or link for every reviewer.
fields.risk: Breaks offline use and puts reviewer notes on a third-party host.

decision.title: The review page makes zero network requests

affects.why: Every save would need the network.

items.title: Export a file now, optional sync later
items.summary: Build the file export first; add sync only if reviewers ask for it.

fields.risk: Two paths to maintain once sync exists.

decision.title: The review page makes zero network requests

affects.why: Offline stays the default; sync would be opt-in.

items.title: Autosave stays in the reviewer's browser only
items.summary: Half-finished answers survive a reload, and are never sent anywhere automatically.

items.title: A reviewer who forgets to send the file is a bigger problem than I make it sound
items.summary: If this happens often, the agent waits silently and the loop stalls.

fields.would_change_my_mind: Reviewers in the first real rounds send files back without a reminder.

items.title: Autosave in the browser can lose work when a reviewer clears their data
items.summary: Answers only become safe once exported.
